name: Cha bo
summary: Chả bò is Da Nang’s beef sausage, known for the local way it is made, and one of the specialty goods to take home from Han Market.
origin: Da Nang. Han Market sells it among the goods to carry home.
howToEat: Buy it at Han Market to take home, or eat in the hall if you are already there for bún chả cá.
where: Han Market, 119 Trần Phú. One clock for the hall is 06:00–19:00, recorded in 2023 and again in 2026. The 2024 account did not restate it.
seoTitle: Cha bo — Da Nang beef sausage
seoDescription: Chả bò is Da Nang’s beef sausage, sold among Han Market’s specialty goods.
